recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the historical #6989 header addition without reopening adjacent overview-dev line-number issues or changing the example structure.
issue_request: FHIR-6989 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the 2015May Developer Overview search-response example. It asked to add HTTP headers because the Search Response example, unlike adjacent examples, did not show associated HTTP headers.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 6416. Git-svn commit d39898a62fc28e007c72230a4001d4bac8f0503f (#6989) added HTTP status and header rows to source/overview-dev.html, including Content-Type and Last-Modified. The current source retained those headers, but the values were stale: XML content type for a JSON body and a Last-Modified date that did not match the Bundle.timestamp described in the notes.
additional_context: source/overview-dev.html is active current-build source via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later work in the same example, including FHIR-7272 and the already-audited FHIR-6991, addressed nearby line-note issues but did not decide these header values. Safe Zulip exact-key/phrase searches and Confluence reference/phrase searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Changed only source/overview-dev.html in the Search Response example: Content-Type is now application/fhir+json, and Last-Modified is now Tue, 19 Aug 2014 15:49:30 GMT to match Bundle.timestamp 2014-08-19T15:49:30Z.
source_changes: source/overview-dev.html: changed the Search Response Content-Type header from application/fhir+xml to application/fhir+json.
source/overview-dev.html: changed the Search Response Last-Modified header from Sun, 17 Aug 2014 15:49:30 GMT to Tue, 19 Aug 2014 15:49:30 GMT to align with Bundle.timestamp.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue corrected Search Response note line references in the same header-bearing example; it supports preserving the header rows while correcting only stale values.

Neighboring 2015May overview-dev issue concerned the timestamp/meta.lastUpdated line note in the same search-response block and was already audited separately; it did not decide the header values fixed here.
